profile.summary: chainhelen is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Express.js backend development. Their contributions focus on optimizing Express core functionality, improving API response handling (particularly `res.send()` chainability), and enhancing test coverage. The developer demonstrates strong proficiency in Node.js backend patterns, dependency management, and test-driven development, with a particular emphasis on clean, maintainable code. While their contributions are backend-focused and lack evidence of frontend frameworks or TypeScript, their work shows a deep understanding of Express internals and testing methodologies. The code quality mindset and attention to detail suggest experience beyond junior level but without the breadth typically associated with senior roles.
